meta.title: Terms of Service — Tesuch (draft)
meta.description: The rules for using Tesuch, the labour-inspection readiness service for employers and accounting firms in Armenia. Draft under lawyer review.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms set out how you may use Tesuch and what we and you are each responsible for. Please read them together with the Privacy notice.

sections.title: About Tesuch
paragraphs: Tesuch (Տեսուչ) is an online service that helps employers and accounting firms in Armenia keep track of labour-law deadlines: probation periods, fixed-term contracts, notice periods and leave. It calculates deadlines, shows findings and a readiness score, sends alerts and prepares document templates.

The service is provided by [Tesuch legal entity, registration number and address — to be added]. By creating an account and accepting these terms, you accept them for yourself and for the organisation you represent.

sections.title: Not legal advice
paragraphs: Tesuch is an information tool, not legal advice. Rules marked “Advisory” have not yet been verified by a lawyer. Before making a decision, consult a lawyer and check the current text of the law on arlis.am.
Nightly checks can be delayed or miss a case if the data is incomplete. You remain responsible for decisions about your employees and for meeting legal deadlines.

sections.title: Accounts and access
items: You sign in with a one-time code sent to your email address. Keep access to that mailbox secure.
The owner of an organisation decides who may access its data and with which role (owner, accountant or viewer).
Tell us at once if you think someone has accessed your account without permission.

sections.title: Your responsibilities for employee data
paragraphs: When you upload data about employees, you (the employer or the accounting firm acting for it) decide why that data is processed. You agree to:
items: have a lawful basis for sharing the data with Tesuch and inform employees about it (we can give you a notice template);
upload only the data the service needs, and keep it accurate;
not upload salaries, passport or ID document data, home addresses, phone numbers, health data or other data the service does not ask for.

sections.title: Personal data
paragraphs: The Privacy notice explains which data we store, where, for how long and what rights people have. For employee data that customers upload, Tesuch acts on the customer’s behalf under a Data Processing Agreement; firm owners can print the template, fill it in and sign it with us.

sections.title: Acceptable use
items: Do not use Tesuch for anything unlawful.
Do not try to access other customers’ data or to get around the service’s security.
Do not overload the service, scrape it automatically or resell it without our written agreement.

sections.title: Availability and changes to the service
paragraphs: We work to keep Tesuch available at all times but cannot guarantee uninterrupted operation. We may improve, change or remove features; we will tell you in advance about changes that significantly affect you.

sections.title: Fees
paragraphs: Fees, if any, are agreed separately in writing. [Pilot terms — to be added.]

sections.title: Liability
paragraphs: [Limitation of liability — to be drafted by the lawyer.] To the extent permitted by law, Tesuch is not liable for fines or other consequences of decisions made on the basis of advisory findings or of incomplete or inaccurate data.

sections.title: Ending the agreement
items: You can close your account at any time. Export your organisation’s data first if you need it.
We may suspend an account that seriously breaks these terms, after warning you where possible.
After an account is closed, data is deleted as described in the Privacy notice.

sections.title: Changes to these terms
paragraphs: Each version of these terms has a version number and a date. If we change them materially, we will ask you to accept the new version the next time you sign in.

sections.title: Governing law
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the law of the Republic of Armenia. Disputes are resolved by [competent court — to be confirmed by the lawyer].

sections.title: Contact
paragraphs: [Tesuch legal entity], [address], [contact email — to be added before launch].

meta.title: Data Processing Agreement (template) — Tesuch (draft)
meta.description: Bilingual (Armenian and English) template of the agreement on processing employee personal data, for employers and accounting firms using Tesuch. Draft under lawyer review.

dpa.intro: For customers who upload employee data: employers and accounting firms. The agreement is in Armenian and English, side by side. [Which language prevails in case of a discrepancy — to be confirmed by the lawyer.]
dpa.howTo: Print it or choose “Save as PDF” in the print dialog, fill in the placeholders in [square brackets] and sign it with Tesuch.

consent.title: Before you continue
consent.intro: Please read and accept the Terms of Service and the Privacy notice. Both are drafts and may change after legal review; if they do, we will ask you again.
points: We store only what the service needs: names, dates of birth, contract and leave dates.
Data is kept in a data centre in Ireland (European Union).
You can ask at any time to access, correct, export or delete your data.
